item.title: Baqaei: Iran to pursue justice for victims of US attack on Lamerd
item.description: Shiraz, IRNA — Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says the United States undoubtedly committed a war crime by using banned weapons in airstrikes on the southern city of Lamerd, emphasizing that Iran is making every effort to pursue justice for the victims of the attack.

item.title: Projectile hits Iranian commercial vessel in Strait of Hormuz, killing one, injuring four
item.description: Qeshm, IRNA – An Iranian commercial container ship was hit by an unidentified projectile early Sunday near Hengam Island in the Strait of Hormuz, killing one crew member and injuring four others, according to the governor of Iran’s Qeshm Island.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86262425/Projectile-hits-Iranian-commercial-vessel-in-Strait-of-Hormuz

item.title: National Bonab Kebab Festival showcases Iran’s culinary heritage
item.description: The ninth National Bonab Kebab Festival opened in Bonab City, East Azerbaijan Province, drawing officials, residents, and tourists. Running through September 15, the event features traditional Bonab kebab alongside cultural and artistic programs and showcases local products, highlighting the city’s growing reputation as a destination for culinary tourism.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86262286/National-Bonab-Kebab-Festival-showcases-Iran-s-culinary-heritage

The ninth National Bonab Kebab Festival opened in Bonab City, East Azerbaijan Province, drawing officials, residents, and tourists. Running through September 15, the event features traditional Bonab kebab alongside cultural and artistic programs and showcases local products, highlighting the city’s growing reputation as a destination for culinary tourism.
